leads.name: mpg123
leads.reason: Selected and verified: libmpg123 feed API decodes the untagged controls; see data/c/mp3/parsers.json.

leads.name: lame
leads.reason: LAME 4.0 exposes the HIP decoder interface, which data/c/mp3_id3v2/parsers.json records as built over libmpg123; it would add a package path, not a separate Layer III decoder family. Not run on the untagged controls.

leads.name: eye-d3
leads.reason: Python ID3 tool; not a C library and tag-only.

leads.name: mad
leads.reason: libmad is an independent fixed-point MPEG audio decoder with a documented mad_stream_buffer/mad_frame_decode/mad_synth_frame byte API; untagged-control adapter, source coverage and AFL++ overlay have not been run in this pilot.

leads.name: ncmdump
leads.reason: Converter for NCM container files; not an MPEG audio decoder library.

leads.name: icecast
leads.reason: Streaming server; no documented MP3 decoding library API.

leads.name: mp3gain
leads.reason: Command-line normalizer; no documented library byte API.

leads.name: mp3splt
leads.reason: Command-line frontend to libmp3splt.

leads.name: mp3val
leads.reason: Command-line MPEG stream validator; no documented library byte API.

leads.name: mp3info
leads.reason: Command-line header viewer and ID3v1 editor; no documented library byte API.

leads.name: libmp3splt
leads.reason: Splitting library whose MP3 plugin decodes through libmad; any path would share the unresolved mad family. Not run.

leads.name: mpg321
leads.reason: Command-line player over libmad; no library input API of its own.

leads.name: clamz
leads.reason: Download client; no MPEG audio parsing.

leads.name: two-lame
leads.reason: MPEG Layer II encoder; no Layer III decoding.

leads.name: mpck
leads.reason: Command-line MP3 checker; no documented library byte API.

leads.name: madplay
leads.reason: Command-line player over libmad; no library input API of its own.

leads.name: overdrive
leads.reason: Shell download script; no MPEG audio parsing.

leads.name: mp3unicode
leads.reason: ID3 tag encoding converter; does not decode MPEG audio frames.

leads.name: mp3wrap
leads.reason: Command-line file wrapper; no library API.

leads.name: mp3check
leads.reason: Command-line MP3 consistency checker; no documented library byte API.

leads.name: mp3cat
leads.reason: Command-line stream concatenation tool; no library API.

leads.name: mp3blaster
leads.reason: Interactive command-line player.

leads.name: whatmp3
leads.reason: Python torrent helper; not a C decoder.

leads.name: mp3fs
leads.reason: FUSE file system that encodes to MP3; not a decoder library.

leads.name: minimp3
leads.reason: Header-only C Layer III decoder (mp3dec_decode_frame on a byte buffer). Not a Homebrew formula, so it has no value on the primary metric; GitHub stars are recorded as supplemental, non-comparable evidence. No tagged release to pin was checked and the untagged-control adapter has not been run.

leads.name: dr_mp3
leads.license: Public domain or MIT-0 (dr_mp3.h header, master branch)
leads.reason: Single-file C decoder in mackron/dr_libs (drmp3_init_memory), whose header states it is based on minimp3, so it likely shares that family. Not a Homebrew formula; repository stars cover all dr_libs headers and are supplemental only. Not run.
